sentences.text:
MCRC No. 7036 of 2023  Shri Shubham Satpute @ Shubbu S/o Shri Sudhakar Satpute,
 presently Aged About 22 Years R/o Pragyapuram, Shankar Nagar,
 Street No. 2, Police Station Dehat Padtala, Chhindwara, District  Chhindwara (M.P.)
 ---- Applicant  Versus  State Of Chhattisgarh Through S.H.O. Durg, District Durg  (Chhattisgarh) ---- Respondent For applicant - Shri Vedant Bhelonde, Advocate.

For Respondent/State - Shri Kashif Shakeel,
Dy.A.G. Hon'ble Shri Justice Goutam Bhaduri Order 15/12/2023 Heard.
1.
This is the third bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C.
The first bail application was dismissed as withdrawn on 02/02/2022 and second bail application was rejected on 09/09/2022.

2. The applicant has preferred this application for grant of bail as he is arrested in connection with Crime No.570/2021 registered in Police Station Durg (C.G.) for offence punishable under sections 363, 366, 376, 403, 420, 511 of IPC and section 4 of POCSO Act.

3. As per the prosecution case, the applicant enticed away the minor girl from the lawful custody of her parents and committed forceful sexual intercourse with her and obtained gold ornaments under different names and subsequently it was revealed that the applicant was fraud.
4.

Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the applicant is in jail since 8/07/2021 and only on the basis of suspicion he has been arrested, therefore he may be enlarged on bail.
5.
Learned State counsel opposes the prayer for grant of bail.
6. Victim appeared through DLSA Durg and she has objected to grant of bail.
7. Having considered the statement of the victim, this court is not inclined to release the applicant on bail.
8. Accordingly, the third bail application is dismissed.
However, the learned trial court is requested to expedite the trial.
